'''Jan te Nijenhuis''' is a Dutch psychologist. He is a lecturer of psychology at the [[University of Amsterdam]], known for his research on [[human intelligence]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.uva.nl/en/profile/n/i/j.tenijenhuis/j.tenijenhuis.html |title=dr. J. (Jan) te Nijenhuis |last=Amsterdam |first=Universiteit van |website=www.uva.nl |language=en |access-date=2018-01-14|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180308005545/https://www.uva.nl/en/profile/n/i/j.tenijenhuis/j.tenijenhuis.html|archive-date=2018-03-08}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.digitaljournal.com/article/352563 |title=Humans getting dumber over the years? |date=2013-06-18 |website=Digital Journal |access-date=2018-01-14}}</ref> He studied at [[Groningen University]] and the [[Free University of Amsterdam]].

His publications on the intelligence of [[Immigration to the Netherlands|immigrants]] have provoked a lot of criticism and controversy in the [[Netherlands]].<ref>Jeroen Trommelen. [https://www.volkskrant.nl/mensen/hoogleraar-drenth-heeft-kritiek-op-conclusies-collega-onderzoeker-over-intelligentie-allochtonen-geen-enkele-test-is-vrij-van-culturele-invloeden~b689d8d7/ Hoogleraar Drenth heeft kritiek op conclusies collega-onderzoeker over intelligentie allochtonen 'Geen enkele test is vrij van culturele invloeden']. ''[[De Volkskrant]]''. January 2, 1998.</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2001-02-03 |title=Niet dommer maar minder intelligent |trans-title=Not dumber but less intelligent |url=https://www.volkskrant.nl/vk/nl/2844/Archief/archief/article/detail/606341/2001/02/03/Niet-dommer-maar-minder-intelligent.dhtml |website=[[De Volkskrant]] |language=nl}}</ref>

He has controversially published several papers in the ''[[Mankind Quarterly]]'' which is widely regarded as a [[racist]] pseudoscience journal and has attended the [[London Conference on Intelligence]].<ref>[https://www.bnnvara.nl/joop/artikelen/nederlandse-psycholoog-trekt-opnieuw-nazi-wetenschap-uit-de-kast Psycholoog trekt opnieuw nazi-wetenschap uit de kast]. [[BNNVARA]]. 03-04-2019. {{quotebox|In addition to the usual professional publications, the psychologist also publishes in controversial publications such as ''Mankind Quarterly'' – described by the American human rights organization [[Southern Poverty Law Center]] as 'the racist pseudo-scholarly Mankind Quarterly' – in which a comeback of eugenics is openly advocated. His papers have titles such as: “Why Do Northeast Asians Win So Few Nobel Prizes?”, “Does cultural background influence the intellectual performance of children from immigrant groups?”, “Group differences in mean intelligence for Dutch and third world immigrants”, “Spearman's hypothesis tested on European Jews vs non-Jewish Whites and vs Oriental Jews: Two meta-analyses”, “Solving the puzzle of why Finns have the highest IQ, but one of the lowest number of Nobel prizes in Europe”, “Spearman's hypothesis tested on Black adults: A meta-analysis”, “Spearman's hypothesis not supported? Three meta-analyses of Black and White prisoners, Northeast Asians, and Arabs and Jews”. }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Van Der Merwe |first1=Ben |title=It might be a pseudo science, but students take the threat of eugenics seriously |date=19 February 2018 |url=https://www.newstatesman.com/politics/education/2018/02/it-might-be-pseudo-science-students-take-threat-eugenics-seriously |access-date=7 December 2018}}</ref>

In June 2019, te Nijenhuis spoke at a meeting of the JFVD, the youth association of the [[far-right]]  [[FvD]] party.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://hardhoofd.com/weerwoord-geobsedeerde-te-nijenhuis-weet-niet-wat-iq-is/ | title=Weerwoord: Geobsedeerde te Nijenhuis weet niet wat IQ is | date=12 June 2019 }}</ref>
